svg.title: Ushuaia to Bordeaux: equirectangular plane and Earth surface
svg.desc: A uniformly scaled EPSG:4087 plane shows a straight distance of 13,370.269 kilometres. An orthographic view of the Atlantic-facing hemisphere places Ushuaia at 54.8019 degrees south and Bordeaux at 44.8378 degrees north; their WGS 84 surface geodesic is 12,750.997 kilometres. Both views share a reference scale of 28 drawing units per 1,000 kilometres, true at the globe centre. Perspective foreshortens the globe near the rim. Coordinates and distance bars appear below.

g.text: Same extent: 125° W–55° E, 90° S–90° N
Surface distances are foreshortened towards the rim
Distance bars share one scale: 28 drawing units = 1 000 km · Same reference scale at globe centre
Illustrative city positions · Distances computed externally · Spatial Types does not calculate distances
